## Welcome to my page!

I am a full-time MPH student at the Johns Hopkins Bloomberg School of Public 
Health, concentrating in Epidemiology and Biostatistics. My research 
interests lie at the intersection of preventive cardiology, pulmonary health, 
and data analysis. Particularly, I am interested in how social determinants of 
health, environmental exposures, and behavioral risk factors influence 
clinical outcomes across diverse populations. I am also 
interested in how emerging technologies, such as artificial intelligence, 
mobile health applications, and digital biomarkers, can be leveraged to 
enhance chronic disease management and preventive care delivery. Building on my 
clinical background, I aim to bridge the gap between 
individual patient care and population-level interventions, 
ultimately contributing to scalable, data-driven, and community-centered 
strategies that advance equitable health outcomes  in cardiopulmonary medicine.
